question: Q3: round 2, call D2 = G(2,7,8,13), quarter-step q4: c = c + d; b = ror7(b ^ c) - degrees of freedom / score-optimal value.
number: No free parameter at this step in the op model: the rotation amount is fixed by the spec, the operand order does not change the op count, and the step has no internal mask. It costs 7 ops in the shipped layout and 7 ops with all internal masks dropped; other layouts give pitch35 x7: 7, pitch34 x7: 8, pitch36 x7 no internal masks: 7, pitch42 x6: 7. So 7 ops is the score-optimal value found; a cheaper-by-one-op case exists only at q3 steps (the internal masks).
